Retired Teacher Couple Held Hostage in Looting Incident

A retired teacher couple was held hostage and looted of approximately ₹8 lakhs in Balaghat. The incident occurred during the day, with the perpetrators allegedly shooting at the couple's daughter before demanding ransom. Police have confirmed that the couple was taken to a nearby location where they were released after the money was handed over. The motive behind the robbery is still unclear.
